comments.value: this is actually a good idea but I see some flaws like people not wearing a avatar that just got put out

WE NEED THIS! Wears/uses and a favorited metric. Maybe lots of people have tried an avatar because it looked cool, but then no one favorited it because it's not worth using? Or maybe lots of people favorited it, but you just don't see it out in the wild so you think it's a failure.

Still wishing for this, somewhere the uploader can check on the website or ingame that tracks the # of favs for an avi and perhaps has a 'heat meter' to show if the avi is actively being used by more or less people relative to the previous check. If it'd be a burden on the servers to track in real time, maybe only check once daily or weekly etc - heck, make it a VRC+ feature if that'd help justify the resources. Having a way to see which of my public avatars are the most liked/used would be super helpful when it comes to maintaining and updating them, would give me feedback on what people like so I can create better content for the platform, and it'd also just be very gratifying to see.

Please 🙏 

I was directed to the canny to check for this, and found this post. 

Creators dont have much insight into if a model is liked or not, outside of maybe 3rd party sale sites and friends sending avatars they see in the wild. (I cant say thats accurate either.)

I want to know which models are most popular so I can bring those features into other avatars. It would also help in knowing which avatars should have priority when updating, or creating new things for them. (It would also help me know what people DONT want.) 

Thanks for reading!
This. I've been wanting this option since 2020.

Please, we need this! The insight it provides would be very helpful and may incentivize me to make even more avis. Currently I don't really make a lot because I don't have the opportunity to know if my avatars are even being seen ;0;
Hope this comes out soon <3 very needed!

details: Should be cool have an counter in our public avatar that show how many people have favorited him. That way we can be able to see if people actually liked our avatar and probably are using sometimes, or we need do more improvements in the model.
title: Count how much people favorited your avatar
